Grace / Aditya — quick note from legal ops after skimming the MAP: a few gating items I want to flag so we don't get a late surprise from Novamed legal: 

- DPA: Novamed is likely to ask for an audit right clause with a vendor performance SLA attached; suggest we proactively offer a scoped SOC2 attestation plus a one-page audit process addendum rather than broad rights.
- Data residency: if they insist on EU/region constraints we should propose a hybrid approach for the pilot (hosted region selection + strict logs retention policy).
- Order form: make the pilot period defined (30 days) and include an acceptance criteria table so procurement can justify go/no-go to finance.

I'll draft a redline for the MSA and a DPA exception request template (DPA-exception-form.pdf) if you want — I can have both to you by EOD 11/10.

—Jonas
